findings.detail: The published 8.0 was assigned to pik_rate, but the source places 8.00% in the Reference Rate and Spread column as S + 8.00%, with no PIK designation.

rationale: Class 1 multi-cell provenance review. Raw source confirms the numeric text pathway for the spread values, including 10.26% at table 8 row 20, but decisively contradicts the pik_rate classification for published 8.0: table 8 row 21 prints S + 8.00% in the Reference Rate and Spread column and does not label it PIK. Thus at least one of the eight flagged cells is a real field-classification error. No aggregate anchor is applicable.
